purpose: Resolve whether the layer-30/31 word-placeholder patch boundary reflects transfer into the answer-position state
system_prompt: Answer the spoken question with one color word.
hook: post-block Thinker residual, full-prompt prefill only; decode-token calls left unchanged
primary_endpoint: complete donor-color answer with normal EOS
interpretation_limit: This is a posthoc fit-only diagnostic after observing the word-placeholder layer sweep. A terminal swap is broad, and an all-audio swap does not isolate a word. A transition in patch sufficiency does not prove a unique circuit.
